candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; inventory reservation succeeds, so the fault is localized to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 but no payment-side logs/metrics were admitted; the underlying payment failure mode (config, saturation, crash) is not established.

report.explanation: All checkout traces show inventory reservation succeeding (200) while payment authorization returns 503, propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Root cause is bounded to the payment dependency; exact payment failure mode requires payment-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics for /v1/authorizations to determine why it returns 503
Payment dependency health/readiness and resource saturation data
